title: Monomial factorization across blocks
statement: Let $s,w$ be natural numbers, let $T$ be a set of coordinates in an array of size $s w$, and let $x$ be a sign assignment to that array. For each block $i$ among the $s$ blocks, take the coordinates of $T$ lying in that block and view them as coordinates among the $w$ positions. Then the monomial of $T$ at $x$ is the product, over all blocks, of the monomial of that block's selected coordinates evaluated on the corresponding block of $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a finite set of coordinates among $s w$ positions
$x$ is a sign assignment on those positions
